svg.text: CLEAR 4 IN IN, 3½ IN UNDER THE TOP
UNDERSIDE CLEAR 4 IN IN FROM THE BACK EDGE
CLAMP BAY — RAIL SET IN 4 IN
NOT TO SCALE · FROM FRONT RIGHT
Plain stile at the kneehole — no bracket
Dimensions in feet and inches. Do not scale.
THE PLAIN DESK — SELECTED. Square corners, no carving,
no corner mouldings: just the square panel mouldings,
reeded top edge, frieze, reeded rail and plinth.
Stiles a plain 1½ in, so the pedestal drawers are wider.
MONITOR CLAMP BAY at the back centre, 10 in wide: the
underside of the top clear 4 in in from the back edge
and 3½ in down; the clamp's body in the 2 in gap to
the glass. Top 1⅝ in solid teak.
